title: Muñal Ɓurngal Sunaare
intro: Mawɗo mo muñal mum wonti legendaire, mo gite mum ɓuuɓtii e sunaare, kono kadi gooŋɗinal mum e peeje diine ɗee meeɗaa ustaade. Oo neɗɗo ina ndaara ɓiɓɓe worɓe sappo e ɗiɗo ina mawna e nder njuɓɓudi leƴƴi, ina tampina ɓiɗɗo ɓurɗo yiɗeede, ina wonta maande muñal belngal e nder mette mawɗe. Ruuhu tedduɗo mo daartol mum haalee e nder kelle wahyu. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ndee limoore e nder Quraan?
clues: Miin ko mi annabi mo daartol mum ina haalee e nder suura mawɗo Quraan.
Miɗo woodi ɓiɓɓe worɓe sappo e ɗiɗo, ɓe laati baabiraaɓe le'i Bani Isra'iila.
Mi wi’i ɓiɓɓe am yo naata e dame ceertuɗe, mbele ɓe nganndee ko ɓe leñol gootol.
Gite am ina mbeltii e woyde ɓiɗɗo giɗo mo ƴettaa e am.
Mi salii 6eydude hoolaare hay so 6i66e am wocf6e 6ee 6eydii kam, mbiyi mi wullitoo tan ko e Alla.
Miin ko mi baaba annabi Yuusuf, innde mum tigi firti ko ‘augmenter’ e ɗemngal aarabeeɓe.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
